searchText: Remember, we aren't working directly with registers -- it takes some work to put together 256-bit operations from 64-bit ones. Complexity analysis and measurements show that MUL is significantly slower than ADD, especially as operands get larger.

excerpts.content: Remember, we aren't working directly with registers -- it takes some work to put together 256-bit operations from 64-bit ones.  Complexity analysis and measurements show that MUL is significantly slower than ADD, especially as operands get larger.
